settings.label: A note on this season
settings.heading: Why ducks, and why for three months
settings.text:
Julia Mind runs one subject at a time. For a quarter, everything in the shop answers to it — the hats, the shirts, the socks, the prints on the wall, the thing stuck to the dashboard. Then the season closes and something else takes over.

Ducks came first because ducks are unreasonably good at this. They work on a bucket hat and they work framed above a kitchen table, and they manage to be funny without asking for attention.

settings.caption: Season 01 — Ducks
settings.label: How the shop works
settings.heading: One subject, three months, then it's gone
settings.text:
Most shops add. This one replaces. Every quarter the whole range is rebuilt around a single subject, so what you find here is a considered set rather than an endless catalogue.

It means the good things sell out and do not come back. It also means nothing sits around for two years looking tired.
I bought the bucket hat as a joke and have now worn it every day for a month. The joke is on me.
settings.author: Rosie, Leeds

settings.text: The print is genuinely lovely — properly framed it does not read as novelty at all, which I did not expect.

settings.question: What actually is a season?
settings.answer: A single subject that the whole shop is built around for three months. Season 01 is ducks. When it closes, the range is replaced rather than added to.

settings.question: What happens to things that sell out?
settings.answer: They stay sold out. Stock is bought once per season, so if something goes early it does not come back.

settings.question: How do the hats fit?
settings.answer: Most bucket hats are a 56–58cm one size. Where a product has several sizes they are listed on its own page — measure around your head just above the ears and go by that.

settings.question: Delivery and returns?
settings.answer: Free UK delivery over £35, worldwide shipping calculated at checkout, and thirty days to send something back unworn and in its packaging.

settings.question: Can I suggest the next season?
settings.answer: Yes, and it works — subjects get chosen partly from what people ask for. Reply to the season letter or send an email.

settings.label: Before it closes
settings.heading: Season 01 runs until the end of the quarter
settings.text: When it ends, what has gone has gone. The next subject has already been chosen and it is not this one.
